descriptions.w3d_cc29b_replace_font_8018dfa0: Fetches and temporarily retains a replacement font/group object, touches the held resource, then adds the mode-selected original component. Replaces the sink field before retaining new/releasing old, replaces the owner field with retain-before-release ordering, releases the temporary handle and returns zero. Four-byte handle view models the observed stack8 slot without claiming the original complete type size.
